messages:
mike: heads up — we need to pick packaging for the Azure private offer (Acme trial). do we ship as a SaaS plan (metered) or a time-limited private-offer SKU? @sophie can you check legal on EULA/terms deltas for private offers?

sophie: looping legal. they want explicit trial period + termination & export-control language. also asked whether we collect telemetry via marketplace consumption events.

andrew: recommend: Trial-30d plan (time-limited, usage cap) instead of per-seat initially — simpler billing and fewer edge cases for partners.

clara: infra checklist: we need publisher tenant id, offer id, managed offer manifest (JSON), and the container image URI (we're not shipping a VM image). who has publisher portal access?

marketplace-bizdev-bot: internal doc: https://internal.re/redwood/marketplace/azure-private-offer — template path: /marketplace/azure/templates/offer.json. sample webhook + ARM snippets in the repo.

mike: can someone paste minimal offer.json snippet we can hand to partner legal?

sophie: here's a minimal example for legal review:
```json
{"offerId":"REDACTED","plans":[{"id":"trial-30d","displayName":"Trial (30 days)","billing":"none","eligibility":"time_limited"}],"termsUrl":"https://redwood.ai/terms/marketplace"}
```

andrew: notes: billing="none" for trial means marketplace consumption won't bill, but we still get marketplace events. we should enable consumption/webhook forwarding so we can instrument conversion. action items: 1) sophie = EULA delta by EOD Thursday; 2) clara = publisher tenant + offer scaffold + ARM/container link; 3) mike = draft listing copy and partner-facing summary.

clara: publisher tenant and RG are ready. uploading ARM + container tags to s3://redwood-marketplace/azure/acme/trial — pushing a versioned manifest now.

mike: thanks. on telemetry: do we need to wire the marketplace consumption events to our billing webhook or only to analytics for the trial?

andrew: wire both. set a stub endpoint for now: POST https://hooks.internal/re/azure-consume (we'll rotate to prod later). Add header X-Marketplace-Signature and validate.

sophie: legal also wants the exact user-facing trial copy. I'll draft a short paragraph and drop in drive; will ping here when done.

mike: final question — private-offer only at launch or public after trial window? preferences?

andrew: private-first, then public if telemetry + conversion pass. keeps risk low. :thumbsup:

mike: agreed. I'll coordinate partner send-off tomorrow morning and update this thread with the final offerId. :white_check_mark:
